### (a) What was done

- `src/explore_persona_space/eval/marker_logprob.py` (f2d01b838): added `MARKER_SLOT_CONTRACT_KEYS = ("logp", "z_marker", "z_eos", "logZ")` and `validate_marker_slot_record(record, *, context, require_z_eos=True, atol=1e-3)` — fails loud (AssertionError naming the offending fields, the contract rule, and incident #530) when a to-be-persisted marker-slot record (one model side) is missing any pre-softmax field, carries non-numeric/bool/non-finite values, has `logp > atol` (a probability/logit stuffed into the log-prob field), or breaks the softmax identity `logp == z_marker − logZ` within `atol` (exact per construction from one forward pass; linearity preserves it for per-batch means, so mean-aggregated records validate too). `require_z_eos=False` escape hatch for capture surfaces explicitly configured without an EOS competitor id; extra keys (e.g. `argmax_id`) allowed.
- Write-time wiring site 1 (f2d01b838): `compute_marker_slot_stats` validates EVERY row immediately after constructing it, while the forward pass still exists — before the row can reach any JSON/WandB sink.
- Write-time wiring site 2 (f2d01b838): `MarkerBandStopCallback.on_step_end` (`src/explore_persona_space/eval/callbacks.py`) validates the trained AND base mean records per probe BEFORE the WandB log and the trajectory-JSON flush; constructing the callback without `eos_token_id` warns that records fall below the contract.
